facts.detail: The GigaHubs Process Review was published on 26 June 2026.
Belmana authored the review with GC Insight for BDUK.
The multi-stage evaluation runs from 2022 to 2027.
The reviewed GigaHubs programme delivered the Hub product during 2021 to 2026.
The Hub product targets remote schools, GP surgeries and libraries.
Connected public buildings are intended to act as anchors for wider rollout.
Eligible sites were typically below 100 Mbps and not commercially connectable.
The study analysed management information covering 2,554 Hubs supported by mid-2024.
The analysis linked management data with DfE datasets and Ofcom Connected Nations.
The review states that 41 GIS intervention areas had been identified across England.
